description:
Owner request (2026-11-10): replace the 'wall of text' Theseus review output with a cleaner, scannable format that shows each finding's importance visually. Audit and proposal (read-only research, mockups rendered via GitHub's Markdown API): ~/.omp/agent/sessions/-Developer-BenchBox/2026-11-02T02-04-38-450Z_01a19a00-60b2-70a6-b56d-6f666415a725/local/review-comment-format-proposal.md.
Measured today vs proposed visible text: SHIP WITH FIXES 6 findings 6,001 -> 861 chars; 1 finding 2,793 -> 505; SHIP 2,891 -> 224; not reviewed 573 (posted twice) -> 197 (once).
Delivery sequence (serial: two repositories and two releases; a registered batch cannot span them):
1. benchbox-review-format-dual-read-20261110 (BenchBox readers accept both formats; closes a fail-open before it can occur)
2. theseus-review-markers-dual-read-20261110, theseus-review-status-descriptions-20261110, theseus-review-not-reviewed-output-20261110 -> theseus-review-format-release-a-20261110
3. benchbox-lock-theseus-review-format-release-a-20261110 (after the v0.2.8 lock and adoption PR)
4. review-minimize-superseded-probe-20261110 (decision gate) -> theseus-review-minimize-superseded-20261110 (or dropped)
5. theseus-review-verdict-body-redesign-20261110, theseus-review-thread-ids-footer-20261110 -> theseus-review-format-release-b-20261110
6. benchbox-lock-theseus-review-format-release-b-20261110
Follow-ups outside the delivery: review-gate-pending-while-waiting-decision-20261110, theseus-review-structured-findings-20261110, theseus-review-format-optional-surfaces-20261110.
Cross-cutting guardrails (each item repeats the ones it needs):
G1 Markers are the API, prose is presentation: never change the review-protocol record, review-defect or review-finding markers; verdict reviews and threads are never edited after posting.
G2 Reader before writer: no release changes a body or thread format until the previous release and BenchBox already read it.
G3 Never weaken a gate: unclassifiable text fails closed; parsed status tokens kept as shared constants; statuses <= 140 chars by test.
G4 Accessibility: every emoji is followed by its bold word; Unicode, not shortcodes; no emoji in commit statuses; severity order most severe first; 'blocks merge' stated in words.
G5 Model text in collapsibles neutralises <details, </details>, <!-- and -->.
G6 No live model or API spend without owner approval; no owner-only actions (stand-ins, adjudications, owner instructions, backoff resets).
G7 Theseus merges: current-head hosted SHIP + green required checks; independent review for gate/receipt/dedup/posting changes and for workflows, policy or lock. BenchBox merges: AGENTS.md write workflow through make pr-arm.
